errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not the bridge this registration belongs to.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists at the given DID.

errors.name: RegistrationNotFound
errors.description: The community has no bridge registration with that id.

errors.name: ChannelNotLinked
errors.description: The channel is neither linked nor open to the registration.

errors.name: RateLimited
errors.description: The bridge sent too many requests. Retry after the interval in the response headers.

owner.description: Whether the account owns the community.

roles.description: Roles held, highest first. Empty when the account is not a member.

member.description: Whether the account is an admitted member that is not banned.

permissions.description: Effective permissions, in the community or in the given channel. Empty when the account is not a member.

channel.description: A linked or open channel of the registration. When given, permissions include that channel's overrides.

community.description: The community the registration belongs to.

main.description: Gets an account's standing in a community for the bridge that holds the registration: whether it is a member, whether it owns the community, its roles and its effective permissions. Bridges use it to decide who may run their commands.
